String.string:
[EN] [Pond Faire] Prepare for the Faire
[ES] [Feria del Estanque] Prepárate para la feria
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I will.
[ES] Lo haré.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I like drums."
[ES] "Me gustan los tambores."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Haroso, the shaman.
[ES] Habla con Haroso, el chamán.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Good Hiding Spot
[ES] Buen escondite
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You found a likely hiding spot.
[ES] Encontraste un posible escondite.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Search for the frightened tuwangi.
[ES] Busca al tuwangi asustado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Play Haroso's drum to give the young tuwangi the courage to come out.
[ES] Toca el tambor de Haroso para darle valor al joven tuwangi y que salga.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The young tuwangi came out of hiding!
[ES] ¡El joven tuwangi salió de su escondite!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Don't be afraid."
[ES] "No tengas miedo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to the frightened tuwangi.
[ES] Habla con el tuwangi asustado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Dragons? Really? Dragons?"
[ES] "¿Dragones? ¿En serio? ¿Dragones?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Haroso.
[ES] Regresa con Haroso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt bubu dragons and collect their meat.
[ES] Caza dragones bubu y recolecta su carne.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Burning Frog Altar
[ES] Altar de la Rana Ardiente
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This is hot enough. Skewer the meat and grill it.
[ES] Esto está lo suficientemente caliente. Ensarta la carne y ásala.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Approach the fire of Burning Frog Altar.
[ES] Acércate al fuego del Altar de la Rana Ardiente.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I hope you like it."
[ES] "Espero que te guste".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Skewer the meat and grill it at the altar.
[ES] Ensarta la carne y ásala en el altar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the dragon on a stick to Haroso.
[ES] Lleva el dragón en brocheta a Haroso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
